requirement_text: Consolidated Prompt: Implement "Profile Information" Module (v2.0) Objective: Extend the "chattocode1" ASP.NET Core 8.0 solution to include a secure "Profile Information" module. This task covers database schema updates, service implementation, and a responsive UI with strict validation and interactive features. 1. Security & Identity Foundation (CRITICAL) Update Account Flow: Ensure the AccountController (Login and Register methods) includes ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier in the ClaimsIdentity, mapped to the user's integer Id from the database. Automatic Login: Upon successful registration, the user must be automatically signed in with the correct claims before redirecting to the Home page. 2. Data Architecture (chattocode1.Model & chattocode1.Data) Extend Person Entity: Add DOB (DateTime?) and ContactNumber (string?). Address Entity: Create an Address entity with: Id, PersonId, AddressType (Enum: Permanent, Communication), AddressLine1, AddressLine2, City, State, and Zipcode. Database Constraints: Use Fluent API in ApplicationDbContext. AddressLine1, City, and Zipcode must be Required (NOT NULL). Relationships: Configure a One-to-Many relationship between Person and Address. Migration: Generate a migration named AddProfileModule and ensure Program.cs is configured to run context.Database.Migrate() on startup. 3. Shared ViewModels (chattocode1.Model) Location: Place all ViewModels in chattocode1.Model/ViewModels to prevent circular dependencies between Services and Presentation. ProfileViewModel: FirstName, LastName, Username: Include these as Read-only properties (no set logic) for display purposes. DOB, ContactNumber: Marked as [Required]. PermanentAddress, CommunicationAddress: Nested AddressViewModel objects. AddressViewModel: Required fields: AddressLine1, City, Zipcode. 4. Business Logic (chattocode1.Services) IProfileService: Define GetProfileAsync(int userId) and UpdateProfileAsync(ProfileViewModel model, int userId). Implementation: UpdateProfileAsync must handle Upsert logic (Update existing or Create new) for both address types. Use an IDbContextTransaction to ensure the entire update (Person + Addresses) is atomic. 5. UI & Presentation (chattocode1.Presentation) ProfileController: Secure with [Authorize]. Implement a robust GetUserId() method that checks for ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier. Self-Healing Session: If the user is authenticated but the ID claim is missing (old cookie), the controller must automatically sign the user out and redirect to Login to refresh the session. Razor View (Views/Profile/Index.cshtml): Fields: Use the readonly HTML attribute for FirstName, LastName, and Username. Validation: Use for all required fields. Interactive JS: Implement a "Same as Permanent Address" checkbox. Use vanilla JavaScript to instantly copy values from Permanent fields to Communication fields when checked. Layout: Add a "Profile" link to the _Layout.cshtml navigation bar, visible only to authenticated users. Acceptance Criteria: Builds Successfully: Zero circular dependencies (Presentation -> Services -> Data -> Model). No Runtime Exceptions: Navigating to /Profile while logged in must load the data without "Claim not found" errors. Data Integrity: Saving the profile updates both the Persons and Addresses tables correctly in one transaction. Client-Side UX: Validation triggers red error messages immediately, and the Address Copy JS works without page refreshes.
